chapters.text: Start a task in the API group: a new workspace on its own git worktree, with Claude ready
The coordinator writes the plan and opens it beside its terminal
It starts a worker in each group, each on its own worktree, and the dots show who is running
The web worker opens the map it changed in a pane beside it
The API worker opens its diff for review
Back with the coordinator, which marks the plan done once both workers finish
